validation.method: Visual inspection of native generated output plus PNG header and SHA-256 verification after workspace copy
checks: Complete ears, horns, wings, paws and tails inside each cell
Original faces, species and palette remain recognizable
validation.limitations: Concept sheets only. Individual transparent production sprites, common anchors and small-size rendering checks will be needed before game integration.

note: Preview artwork only; no live asset or balance changes. Existing project pet references supplied by the user project; their earlier provenance is not independently audited here. No external media downloaded.

assets.name: Зая
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished concept comparison sheet for six level-dependent cosmetic appearances of one existing browser-game pet. Reference image 1 supplies exact character identity, rendering style, colours, facial expression, body proportions and full seated pose. Create a NEW opaque landscape comparison board, aspect ratio 3:2, with a clean warm ivory background, very subtle gold divider lines and understated purple typography. Six equally sized cells, exactly two rows of three. Levels run left-to-right: 0, 1, 2 in top row and 3, 4, 5 in bottom row. All six are the SAME character at the SAME body size, pose, viewing direction and light, with accessories changing only. Render the ENTIRE full-body pet in every cell with generous safe margins around ears, paws, tail, wings, crown. No cropping, no circle portrait, no badge frame, no overlap between cells, no extra characters. Use exquisite friendly fantasy game illustration like the reference: large expressive eyes, clean shiny material shading, soft detailed fur or scales. Crisp silhouettes readable when small; add beautiful textile/metal craftsmanship instead of many gemstones. Each level retains the earlier accessories and adds or upgrades the stated item. Clothes must not obscure face or anatomy. Each cell has its centered caption BELOW the pet, exactly: "Уровень 0", "Уровень 1", "Уровень 2", "Уровень 3", "Уровень 4", "Уровень 5". A small elegant centered name at the top only, no additional text, no game branding, no watermark. The purpose is an attractive clearly readable comparison for approval, not a sprite atlas. Character: Зая, the exact white fluffy lop-eared bunny from the reference, blue eyes, pink ear interiors, pink nose, cheek blush, delighted open-mouth smile, small forepaws, full long ears. Top title exactly "Зая". Accessories theme: forest enchantress, lilac fabrics and leaf-shaped gold craft.
Level 0: natural white fur only; REMOVE the reference's bow and gemstone, entirely no clothing or jewellery.
Level 1: one small plain lilac silk bow at the neck, no jewel.
Level 2: same bow, add a recognizable small GOLD CARROT brooch at its knot, green enamel carrot leaves, no gemstone.
Level 3: retain bow/carrot brooch, add a short pale-lilac cape with elegant small gold leaf embroidery.
Level 4: retain previous, add a delicate thin gold leaf tiara between ears and one small gold bracelet on forepaw.
Level 5: upgrade to richer purple and ivory cape with gold leaf borders and a refined larger leafy tiara, retain bow/carrot/bracelet, a few very restrained soft golden sparkles close to the silhouette. The bunny remains visibly the same cute bunny, not bigger or older.
